description.value: Señor Froggy is a Mexican fast-food restaurant located in a multi-unit commercial building on Sydney Avenue in Kamloops' North Shore. The restaurant operates a salsa bar and offers a catering service alongside its regular menu. Cyclists passing through this part of Kamloops would find a Mexican food option with gluten-friendly menu items.
